fields.name: ChangedFlags
fields.evidence: Server can-sense update bg3.exe+0x3409EE0 (macOS esv::capability::CanSenseSystem::Update) computes the new eoc::CanSenseComponent flags (uint16), and stores old ^ new (or new ^ 0x10 when the CanSense component is created) into this 2-byte component through bg3.exe+0x340AA80 when non-zero - the bits that changed. AwarenessCapabilityFlags is SE's uint16_t bitmask of eoc::CanSenseComponent.Flags (Enumerations/ECS.inl). Live: 0x02..0x24. Declared as uint16_t (the underlying type of SE's AwarenessCapabilityFlags, which generate.py does not size); the adder bg3.exe+0x340AA80 registers frame storage of element size 2 for this one-frame type.

second_pass: Width re-checked in the Windows adder bg3.exe+0x340AA80 (2-byte one-frame storage) and the type changed from the SE enum AwarenessCapabilityFlags to its underlying uint16_t so that generate.py accepts the file.
